spec.title: Market Microstructure (Rotation) v2
spec.description: Both legs of a pair_trade rotation: L1–L5 book (QuestDB ISIN) + strategy overlays (Postgres). Panel time = rotation Tehran wall −5m … +10m (vars win_from/win_to; not the top time picker). Default: session 58 / rotation 3141 (Nov 8 درخشان→رز ترنج).

spec.__legacyStringValue: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.id::text || ' @ ' || to_char(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, s.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.session s JOIN pair_trade.strategy st ON st.id = s.strategy_id WHERE st.name = '$strategy' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC;

SELECT r.id::text || ' · ' || r.prev_symbol || '→' || r.new_symbol || ' · ' || r.status || ' @ ' || to_char(r.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran', 'HH24:MI:SS') AS __text, r.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.rotation r WHERE r.session_id IN ($session) ORDER BY r.ts DESC;
SELECT COALESCE(split_part(sell_pair,'-',1), 'IRTKDRKS0001') AS __value, prev_symbol || ' · ' || COALESCE(split_part(sell_pair,'-',1), '?') AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;
SELECT COALESCE(split_part(buy_pair,'-',1), 'IRTKROSE0001') AS __value, new_symbol || ' · ' || COALESCE(split_part(buy_pair,'-',1), '?') AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(intended_sell_price, 0))::bigint::text AS __value, ROUND(COALESCE(intended_sell_price, 0))::bigint::text AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(intended_buy_price, 0))::bigint::text AS __value, ROUND(COALESCE(intended_buy_price, 0))::bigint::text AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;

SELECT to_char((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') - interval '5 minutes', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS __value, to_char((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') - interval '5 minutes', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;

SELECT to_char((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') + interval '10 minutes', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS __value, to_char((ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') + interval '10 minutes', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM pair_trade.rotation WHERE id = $rotation;

spec.title: Rotation summary
spec.description: Postgres pair_trade.rotation (+ first buy fill lag). n/a = no fill / not completed.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.status,
  COALESCE(ROUND((r.buy_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2)::text, 'n/a') AS buy_slip_bps,
  COALESCE(ROUND((r.sell_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2)::text, 'n/a') AS sell_slip_bps,
  COALESCE(ROUND(r.latency_sec::numeric, 1)::text, 'n/a') AS latency_sec,
  COALESCE(
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MIN(f.ts) - r.ts))::numeric, 1)::text,
    'n/a (no buy fill)'
  ) AS sec_to_first_buy_fill,
  ROUND(r.intended_buy_price::numeric, 0) AS intended_buy,
  ROUND(r.intended_sell_price::numeric, 0) AS intended_sell
FROM pair_trade.rotation r
LEFT JOIN pair_trade.fill f
  ON f.rotation_id = r.id AND upper(f.side) = 'BUY'
WHERE r.id = ${rotation}
GROUP BY r.id, r.status, r.buy_slippage, r.sell_slippage, r.latency_sec,
         r.intended_buy_price, r.intended_sell_price, r.ts;

spec.title: Sell leg · L1–L5 + intended/fills
spec.description: QuestDB depth for $isin_sell + intended_sell. Yellow points = sell fills (Postgres).

spec.rawSql:
WITH ob AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='1' THEN price END) AS bid1,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='2' THEN price END) AS bid2,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='3' THEN price END) AS bid3,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='4' THEN price END) AS bid4,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='5' THEN price END) AS bid5,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='1' THEN price END) AS ask1,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='2' THEN price END) AS ask2,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='3' THEN price END) AS ask3,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='4' THEN price END) AS ask4,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='5' THEN price END) AS ask5
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${isin_sell}'
    AND is_deleted = false
    AND timestamp BETWEEN '${win_from}' AND '${win_to}'
    AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
),
dr AS (
  SELECT timestamp, day_range_min, day_range_max
  FROM day_range_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${isin_sell}' AND is_deleted = false
)
SELECT ob.timestamp AS time,
  ob.bid1, ob.bid2, ob.bid3, ob.bid4, ob.bid5,
  ob.ask1, ob.ask2, ob.ask3, ob.ask4, ob.ask5,
  (ob.bid1 + ob.ask1) / 2 AS mid,
  dr.day_range_min, dr.day_range_max,
  ${intended_sell} AS intended_sell
FROM ob
ASOF JOIN dr;

spec.title: Buy leg · L1–L5 + intended/fills/fails

    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='2' THEN price END) AS ask2,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='3' THEN price END) AS ask3,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='4' THEN price END) AS ask4,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='5' THEN price END) AS ask5
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${isin_buy}'
    AND is_deleted = false
    AND timestamp BETWEEN '${win_from}' AND '${win_to}'
    AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
),
dr AS (
  SELECT timestamp, day_range_min, day_range_max
  FROM day_range_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${isin_buy}' AND is_deleted = false
)
SELECT ob.timestamp AS time,
  ob.bid1, ob.bid2, ob.bid3, ob.bid4, ob.bid5,
  ob.ask1, ob.ask2, ob.ask3, ob.ask4, ob.ask5,

SELECT (e.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AS time,
  ${intended_buy}::float8 AS buy_fail
FROM pair_trade.event_log e
JOIN pair_trade.rotation r ON r.session_id = e.session_id AND r.id = ${rotation}
WHERE e.session_id IN (${session})
  AND e.event_type = 'order_end'
  AND e.payload->>'side' = 'buy'
  AND e.payload->>'reason' = 'failed'
  AND e.ts BETWEEN r.ts - interval '2 minutes' AND r.ts + interval '30 minutes';

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='1' THEN volume END) AS bid1_vol,
  -avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='1' THEN volume END) AS ask1_vol_neg
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${isin_sell}'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '${win_from}' AND '${win_to}'
  AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

SELECT timestamp AS time,
  avg(CASE WHEN side='bid' AND level='1' THEN volume END) AS bid1_vol,
  -avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='1' THEN volume END) AS ask1_vol_neg
FROM orderbook_historical
WHERE symbol = '${isin_buy}'
  AND is_deleted = false
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '${win_from}' AND '${win_to}'
  AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR;

spec.title: Would waiting help? · ask ≤ intended_buy
spec.description: HOW TO READ: Purple = signal intended_buy. Red = live L1 ask. Dashed dark-red = aggressive limit (ask×(1+buy_slippage_bps)). Green bars (right axis) = L1 ask size ONLY when ask ≤ intended (passive fill was possible). If ask stays above purple and green never appears → waiting would NOT get you filled at intended; you needed to cross or abandon. If green bars appear later → a patient limit at intended could have filled.

spec.rawSql:
WITH ob AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='1' THEN price END) AS ask1,
    avg(CASE WHEN side='ask' AND level='1' THEN volume END) AS ask1_vol
  FROM orderbook_historical
  WHERE symbol = '${isin_buy}'
    AND is_deleted = false
    AND timestamp BETWEEN '${win_from}' AND '${win_to}'
    AND hour(timestamp) >= 12 AND hour(timestamp) < 18
  SAMPLE BY ${bucket} ALIGN TO CALENDAR
)
SELECT time,
  ask1,
  ask1 * (1.0 + ${buy_slippage_bps} / 10000.0) AS aggressive_buy,
  ${intended_buy} AS intended_buy,
  CASE WHEN ask1 <= ${intended_buy} THEN ask1_vol ELSE NULL END AS passive_vol
FROM ob;

spec.title: Rotation slippage breakdown
spec.description: Stored rotation fields. buy_slip mixes wait+cross+impact; use depth/CF panels to unbundle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.id AS rotation_id,
  r.status,
  r.prev_symbol || ' → ' || r.new_symbol AS legs,
  r.intended_sell_price,
  r.sell_vwap,
  ROUND((r.sell_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2) AS sell_slip_bps,
  r.intended_buy_price,
  r.buy_vwap,
  ROUND((r.buy_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2) AS buy_slip_bps,
  ROUND(r.latency_sec::numeric, 1) AS latency_sec,
  ROUND(r.last_edge::numeric, 6) AS last_edge,
  ROUND(r.realized_edge::numeric, 6) AS realized_edge,
  ROUND(r.transition_score::numeric, 6) AS expected_edge,
  (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AS tehran_ts
FROM pair_trade.rotation r
WHERE r.id = ${rotation};

spec.title: Session · latency vs buy slip
spec.description: Non-cash rotations with buy fill. Sort/scan for slow+expensive outliers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(r.latency_sec, 0)::float8 AS latency_sec,
  (r.buy_slippage * 10000)::float8 AS buy_slip_bps,
  r.status
FROM pair_trade.rotation r
WHERE r.session_id IN (${session})
  AND r.prev_symbol <> 'CASH'
  AND r.buy_slippage IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: Session rotations
spec.description: Pick a row's id in the Rotation variable. Tehran wall clock.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.id,
  (ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran') AS tehran_ts,
  r.prev_symbol,
  r.new_symbol,
  r.status,
  ROUND((r.sell_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2) AS sell_slip_bps,
  ROUND((r.buy_slippage * 10000)::numeric, 2) AS buy_slip_bps,
  ROUND(r.latency_sec::numeric, 1) AS latency_sec,
  ROUND(r.intended_buy_price::numeric, 0) AS intended_buy,
  ROUND(r.buy_vwap::numeric, 0) AS buy_vwap
FROM pair_trade.rotation r
WHERE r.session_id IN (${session})
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 100;
